description: Recorded World ID Selfie Check responses from the live sandbox, captured 2026-09-09. Replayed offline so tests never depend on a phone, a camera, or the World verifier being reachable.

captures.note: First verification. Upstream message has no reuse annotation.
Same person, same action, fresh proof. Identical nullifier; upstream annotates '(nullifier reuse)' and STILL returns success:true.

expected_check_results.note: What a correct implementation must conclude when replaying the two captures above.

known_gotchas: Field elements are UNPADDED hex: merkle_root came back 63 chars in capture 01 and 64 in capture 02. Nullifiers have the same property, so store them as NUMERIC(78,0) decimal, never as text.
The verifier returns success:true on a reused nullifier and only annotates the message string. Replay protection is entirely the integrator's — the unique index is the control.
upstream created_at is identical in both captures despite hours between them: it is when the nullifier was FIRST seen, not when this proof was verified. Use your own clock.

signal_hash here is the hash of the EMPTY signal, which is also the documented default. The v4 verify endpoint is never told which signal you expected, so comparing signal_hash against hashSignal(yourSignal) is your job.
Legacy presets return the user's MAXIMUM credential: requesting selfieCheckLegacy can return an Orb credential, so identifier is not guaranteed to be 'selfie'.
